description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

NSU AWAC Services Company, part of Allied World, is seeking an Associate Application Developer to build and support AI-powered applications and automation solutions. The role focuses on LLM prompt development, Python application components, React interfaces, REST API integrations, and collaboration with business and technology teams.
Associate Application Developer building AI-powered applications and automation with Python, React, LLM prompts, and REST API integrations

Responsibilities:
• Assist in designing, developing, and supporting AI-powered applications and automation solutions
• Create, test, and optimize prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve accuracy and business outcomes
• Develop application components and integrations using Python
• Build and maintain user interfaces using React JS
• Consume and integrate REST APIs to connect enterprise systems and AI services
• Collaborate with business and technology teams to deliver innovative AI-driven solutions
• Participate in testing, troubleshooting, and application support activities

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
• Basic knowledge of **Python** programming
• Familiarity with **React JS**
• Understanding of **REST APIs**, JSON, and application integration concepts
• Foundational knowledge of **AI, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, and Large Language Models (LLMs)**
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
• Eagerness to learn and work in a collaborative environment

Preferred:
• Exposure to AI platforms such as Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or similar technologies
• Academic projects, internships, or personal projects involving AI, automation, or software development
